rv.q: But Harris’s script is just not clever or enchanting enough for the grownups, and is like a panto in its humour.

It's no mean feat (pun intended) to make a fist of this and it’s to Rampersad’s credit that she almost achieves the impossible and delivers something that serves all the forces pulling in opposing directions.

But adapter Nancy Harris and director/choreographer Kimberly Rampersad have failed to meld the separate styles into a whole; this is not a satisfying patchwork; it is a random set of jumble randomly stitched together.

cn.t: The RSC's adaptation of the dark fairytale receives mixed reviews, with critics finding the production muddled and frustrating despite strong performances, particularly from Nikki Cheung as the dancing-obsessed girl.
